title: Lake Fairview Marina
specs: Lake Fairview is a 405-acre spring-fed lake with clear water
Lake Fairview is 15 minutes from downtown Orlando
Windsurfing and wing foil lessons taught by experienced instructors with over 20 years teaching
Pets allowed on standard pontoon boats up to 50 lbs with $75 refundable deposit
No fishing or pets allowed on upgraded pontoon boat
Minimum 2 students required to schedule group sailing lesson
No sailing experience required for ASA 101 course
No experience needed for AquaCat paddle boat
Safety equipment must be worn as directed
Standard pontoon fits up to 8 guests

blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats, kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, AquaCat pedal boats, and sailboats on Lake Fairview. Sailing lessons with ASA 101 certification and windsurfing and wing foil lessons are also offered. The marina provides launch assistance and safety equipment.
